title: statusline r2 SA+UX: install happy path has no acceptance criterion
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lenses: solution-architect and ux (cross-lens duplicate merged at filing; validators: solution-owner, documentation-reviewer). Owner: SO session. Defect: the only path that WRITES adopter-owned settings — absent statusLine, operator confirms, default wiring installed — has no falsifiable coverage, and the decline outcome is unstated; Install behaviors tests only refuse-existing and malformed paths; the fixture corpus names no settings-absent/existing-statusLine/over-width members (symptom of the same gap). Citations verified: contract:159 vs :184, :170. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: wrong wiring, write-without-confirmation, or fail-to-write-on-confirmation all pass CI on the fresh-operator path most adopters traverse.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Install behaviors criterion now verifies the write path and decline outcome: statusLine-absent + confirmation receives default wiring rendering a working segment; decline leaves settings untouched with manual invocation available. Fixture corpus gains named members: install-offer settings fixtures (absent-confirmed, absent-declined, present, malformed) and an over-width segment field. Revision: Install behaviors criterion + fixture corpus.
